NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed one new commit that renames the commit to "drafts: Preserve focus on draft action controls." The code is unchanged. The subject line now follows Zulip style, which was the only open ask.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Commit subject now follows the style guide: area prefix, capitalized, ends with a period |
| ❌  | The description says `Fixes: issue-#39005`, which isn't the `Fixes: #39005` format, so GitHub doesn't link the issue |
| ⚠️  | The linked-issues list is empty, so I can't confirm the issue has "help wanted" (the author has no merged PRs) |
| ℹ️  | The commit message body isn't visible in the input, so I couldn't check it beyond the subject |

###### Next step

"not ready" stays until the `Fixes:` line is corrected; once the issue is confirmed "help wanted", remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm, who gave the feedback.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the commit message, the subject looks good now. Could you change the description's `Fixes: issue-#39005` to `Fixes: #39005` (and make sure the commit message has the same line) so the issue links properly? After that this should be ready for review.
```
